scripts.server: npm run db:check && npm run dev --prefix server
scripts.dev: npm run docker:up && npm run db:check && concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run client"
scripts.test:behaviour: npm run db:check && npm run test:behaviour --prefix server
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
